name: R198 Group Runner Probe
brief: R198: can one call run N test methods with per-method isolation and cross-session progress?
description: Throwaway probe. Measures a custom TestRunner with TestIsolation = Function driven through Test Suite Mgt.: per-method rollback, whether a Commit in the runner triggers leaks test writes, whether progress written there is readable from a second session, and whether OnBeforeTestRun returning false stops at the first failure.
